programme.title: Halloween With The New Addams Family
programme.desc: Burglars spend a hair-raising night among the bizarre guests at a weird clan's (John Astin, Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan) annual party.

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: After losing yet another job, George (Weird Al Yankovic) wonders if there is any career that can handle his outrageous personality. When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
programme.desc: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: Employee of the Month

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Tough Love
programme.desc: Madea gets herself into outrageous situations while helping children save their youth center.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy

programme.desc: Dog playing fetch by himself; scrub playing shell game; golf ball hits cameraman; cat doing many flips chasing a toy mouse.

programme.title: Just for Laughs: Gags
programme.desc: A bride picks up her groom and then both fall in the water, twins trick participants by switching sandwich boards, and the top three paramedic gags are just the cherry on top.

programme.title: Just for Laughs: Gags
programme.desc: A girl frees a prisoner using her diary's key, a vacuum cleaner sucks up a salesman's wig, and the three firefighter gags bring the heat.

programme.title: I Hate Kids
programme.desc: Nick Pearson is a life-long bachelor who is finally settling down. On the brink of his wedding, he is surprised to find he has a 13-year-old son who located him through the help of a psychic. Nick can't stand kids and would happily send the boy back to live with his biological mother, but nobody knows who the woman might be. Having nowhere to turn, Nick must hit the road with the boy and the neurotic psychic to locate dozens of his ex-flings and ask one very awkward question to all of them.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: When French drug kingpin Philippe Douvier (Robert Webber) learns that he's losing the respect of New York mob bosses, he decides to murder Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Peter Sellers) to regain his reputation. After a case of mistaken identity, Clouseau is declared dead, much to the delight of his former boss, Charles Dreyfus (Herbert Lom). When Clouseau reemerges, he teams up with Douvier's ex-lover, Simone LeGree (Dyan Cannon), to break up the drug trafficking operation.

programme.title: Larger Than Life
programme.desc: Jack Corcoran (Bill Murray) is a struggling motivational speaker who lives by the mantra Get over it! When he learns his circus clown father has died and left him Vera, an 8,000-pound elephant, as an inheritance, he considers only one option: selling his father's beloved pet. He finds two buyers -- but must then get Vera to California, thousands of miles away, in just five days. With the help of an eccentric truck driver (Matthew McConaughey), Jack and Vera set out on one crazy road trip.

programme.title: She's Back
programme.desc: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Night of the Comet
programme.desc: After a rare comet sighting, teen sisters Regina (Catherine Mary Stewart) and Samantha (Kelli Maroney) find that they're among the only survivors of a zombie attack. The girls partner with another survivor, Hector (Robert Beltran), but as they try to avoid the zombies, they're sought by scientists who want to experiment on their bodies in the hope of finding an antidote. Dodging both the doctors and the undead, they keep moving in the hope that they can continue to stay alive.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: A diabolical Mr. Reed ensnares two young missionaries in a terrifying game of cat and mouse when they knock on the wrong door and are forced to prove their faith.

programme.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again
programme.desc: For years, Jon Porter (Michael Gross) has been repressing memories of how his older sister was murdered -- and how he electrocuted her three assailants to death. Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed.

programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
programme.desc: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: A year after a severe emotional trauma, Sarah (Shauna Macdonald) goes to North Carolina to spend some time exploring caves with her friends; after descending underground, the women find strange cave paintings and evidence of an earlier expedition, then learn they are not alone: Underground predators inhabit the crevasses, and they have a taste for human flesh.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move

However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Apache Junction
programme.desc: Apache Junction is an Old West outpost of lawlessness, a haven for thieves and cold-blooded killers. When big-city reporter Annabelle Angel arrives in town and becomes a target, notorious gunslinger Jericho Ford comes to her aid. Now, Annabelle must entrust her future to a man with a deadly past as Jericho heads toward a tense showdown.

programme.title: The Old Way
programme.desc: Retired gunslinger Colton Briggs faces the consequences of his past when the son of a man he murdered arrives to take his revenge. Briggs must take up arms once more after his wife is killed, and is joined by his young daughter.

programme.title: Timecop
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: A Midnight Clear
programme.desc: In the winter of 1944, American soldiers led by Will Knott (Ethan Hawke) are assigned to capture a small squad of German soldiers posted in France's Ardennes forest. Tired of war, the Americans have already lost half their division and discover that their German enemy is equally unwilling to fight. With Jewish soldier Stan Shutzer (Arye Gross) interpreting, the Germans and Americans agree on a plan that will let the former surrender without violence -- but then, tragedy strikes.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: A Room With a View
programme.desc: In this British drama based on the novel by E.M. Forster, Lucy Honeychurch, a young Englishwoman, is touring Italy with her older cousin. At a hotel in Florence, Lucy meets the charming and free-spirited George Emerson. Although intrigued by George, once she's back in England Lucy ponders settling down with the wealthy, staid Cecil Vyse. When George reappears in her life, Lucy must decide between him and Cecil.

programme.title: Coffee and Cigarettes
programme.desc: This 11-vignette film focuses on the human interactions that happen while partaking in the everyday indulgence of coffee and cigarettes. Featuring well-known actors and other artists as themselves or some version thereof, the film highlights the nuances and subtle hostilities that can be a part of seemingly normal conversations. Bill Murray waits on the Wu-Tang Clan, Iggy Pop and Tom Waits get on each other's nerves and Jack and Meg White of the White Stripes discuss Nikola Tesla.

programme.title: The TV Set
programme.desc: Mike Klein (David Duchovny), the creator of a TV pilot called "The Wexler Chronicles," learns the hard way about how television shows evolve from concept to reality. Though Mike's concept involves serious subject, a network executive (Sigourney Weaver) and her cohorts have other plans to lighten up and dumb down the show to appeal to a broader audience.

programme.title: Wild Side
programme.desc: When bank executive Alex Lee (Anne Heche) turns to prostitution in order to make ends meet, she becomes a high-class call girl for criminal clientele like notorious money launderer Bruno Buckingham (Christopher Walken). But, after she's framed by an undercover agent working as Bruno's chauffeur, Alex is forced to help the FBI bring Bruno to justice. Backed into a corner with no way out, Alex decides to make a run for it with Bruno's wife, Virginia (Joan Chen), with whom she's fallen in love.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it.

programme.title: Karate Killer
programme.desc: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: Life on Earth is rapidly destroyed except for a small area in Eastern Europe.

programme.title: Chopping Mall
programme.desc: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

programme.title: Tragedy Girls
programme.desc: Teenage crime reporters Sadie and McKayla are hot on the trail of a crazed serial killer. After capturing the maniac and holding him hostage, they soon realize that the best way to boost their social media stardom is to commit the murders themselves.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
programme.desc: Movie star Roxy Carmichael is abandoning the bright lights of Hollywood, Calif. And returning to her small Ohio hometown -- at least long enough to dedicate a city building. And now the whole town of Clyde is bracing for Carmichael's return, most of all her now-married old flame Denton Webb and troubled teen Dinky Bossetti. An orphan with few friends, Dinky is convinced that Carmichael is her birth mother, and that the actress will reclaim her when she returns.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: David Kepesh (Ben Kingsley), a renowned professor, has no interest in monogamy. Instead, he prefers to dabble in lustful flings with women. When he meets Consuela Castillo (Penélope Cruz), a student in her 20s, he is intensely attracted to her. Though his trusted friend George (Dennis Hopper) warns him not to become overly attached to the much younger Consuela, David begins to feel that his relationship with the student may become serious. However, his personal reservations may doom the affair.

Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

Paul decides to approach his idol, but the encounter goes very badly.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: Both sides utilized air power during the Vietnam War, but the United States ruled the skies. The American pilots often were the factors that turned the fortunes of battles by interrupting enemy supply lines and communications, as well as gathering reconnaissance information for the ground troops. Despite the overwhelming success, it didn't produce victory. Vietnam air tactics broke the prior mold.

programme.title: Rommel's Afrika Korps Defeated
programme.desc: 1943 Axis Smashed in North Africa After battles across North Africa Montgomery and Eisenhower's armies meet up. Tunisia is liberated and the celebration is seen as a forerunner of victories to come in Europe. Vivid wartime footage.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944, 9:30 PM. 13,348 men from two American parachute divisions, the 82nd and the 101st Airborne in nearly 1,000 aircraft will take off to Normandy. Until then, no one had launched an airborne operation of this scale. The Allied staff is expecting huge losses! Some forecasts predict 75% of the paratroopers will fall in combat. They must open the way to the troops landing on Utah Beach.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: The Night of the Long Knives: Hitler's Rise to Power
programme.desc: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany, and in Hitler's rise to power, that led to this purge in 1934? Caught between the conservative tendency and the revolutionary aspirations that were dividing the country, the Chancellor had a choice. To calm the rumors of a military coup against him, Hitler sent a clear message.

programme.title: Fighter Aircraft: The Quest For Speed
programme.desc: The rare combination to power and grace lends high performance aircraft a fascination all their own. Hurdling through the atmosphere at extraordinary velocities they traverse oceans and continents, accomplishing in a few hours what journeys would cost in painful labor and time. Making these airplanes faster has been a long endeavor in fuel and technology. One element remains constant - pilots.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The fourth episode sees the Germans well and truly on the retreat and the Allies are able to successfully implement operation Husky - the landing on Sicily - where General Montgomery and the American General George Smith Patton ousted the Germans in little over five weeks. On the Eastern Front General Zhukov inflicted heavy defeat on the Germans now having the new T - 54 tank available.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the brutal effort to take the Palau islands. On Peleliu, U.S. forces encounter fierce fighting from well fortified and entrenched Japanese soldiers. The U.S. eventually push the Japanese back to Bloody Nose Ridge where some of the bloodiest fighting on the war takes place. After weeks of fighting, the Allies finally secure the island.
programme.sub-title: Palau: The Fight for Bloody Nose Ridge

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: The 20th century saw a deadly leap in technology. This episode explores mankind's most fearsome creations-chemical, atomic, robotic, and nuclear weapons. From banned gases to bombs that level cities, it's the story of ultimate destruction. Some were used, others were not-but all redefined the scale of warfare and the terrifying potential of future conflicts.

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: ANZAC troops dig into trench warfare along the Western Front in early 1916.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: After the failure to take both Moscow and Leningrad, Hitler sets his sights on the oil fields in the Caucasus. If captured, the Red Army will lose 70-90% of all its oil resources. Therefore, the famous city on the Volga, Stalingrad, must be 'held at all costs.' The German General Staff thinks taking the city will be a matter of a few weeks, but events steadily turn against the Germans.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After six months of retreat across Northern Europe, Adolf Hitler's forces on the Western Front are back behind Germany's borders. For the Allies the war seems almost over, as they pause to plan for the final drive to Berlin. But The Fuhrer has other plans - he has one last unexpected card to play.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: The Marines hoist the flag after a bloody victory at Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Baby Cages: The Denazification Of Hitler Youth
programme.desc: In a final insane attempt to turn the tide of the war, Hitler recruited from the Hitler Youth, enlisting children as young as 12 years old. Around 10,000 of these young fighters, who were both persecutors and victims, would be taken prisoner by the Americans. A re-education program started at Attichy Camp to steer them towards an attitude of tolerance and democracy. It was called 'Baby Cages'.

programme.title: Stalin's Executioners: The Katyn Massacre
programme.desc: This film tells for the first time the story of the Katyn massacre seen from both sides: That of the victims and that of the perpetrators. It reveals how this crime, attributed to the Nazis for 50 years, was in fact carried out by the Soviet secret police, the NKVD.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Falklands War
programme.desc: The Battle between the UK and Argentina over claims to the Falkland Islands systematically merged weapons technology of air, sea, and ground. A UK invasion yielded a bombardment of speed, weaponry and destruction.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The American Navy got back on course after Pearl Harbour, and in the four-day Battle for the Coral Sea, they claimed victory, before defeating Japan again in the decisive Battle of Midway. Elsewhere the Luftwaffe targeted more British cities.
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Midway and Beyond: April-June 1942

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Gen. Eisenhower addresses troops in Southern England; the 'Big Show' begins; airborne troops dropped behind enemy lines; support aircraft drop everything from howitzers to motorcycles; bombers blast bridges and supply lines; sea forces bombard enemy fortifications on French coast; British and second army swarm over coast at Omaha and Utah Beaches; German west wall broken.
programme.sub-title: D-Day - The Battle in the Air

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Allied troops invade southern France near Toulon in a combined amphibious and airborne assault. A coastal village is occupied after a raging battle between coastal batteries and naval guns. French underground members welcome the allies. Shows Gen. Patch, James Forrestal, and Adm. Hewitt in a landing craft.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: The SS and The Occult
programme.desc: This powerful film revisits the sites most closely associated with Heinrich Himmler and traces the development of his warped ideology. Heinrich Himmler was the creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. He was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past. The occult roots of the Third Reich are discussed.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: Before WWII, bombs dropped from balloons and Zeppelins hinted at a new horror. Between the wars, bombing campaigns escalated worldwide-from Shanghai to Guernica. Populations realized that in modern war, no one was safe. The bomber had arrived-not just as a weapon, but as a harbinger of total war.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Terrorism
programme.desc: The very nature of terrorism has changed. Suicide Bombings, Hijacking, violent attacks, and the taking of hostages has become the standard.

programme.title: About Executing Eichmann
programme.desc: Jewish historians and thinkers dwell on the importance of Eichmann's trial in Israël's history and on the violent debates provoked by his death sentence in the 60's in the intellectual and political sphere.

programme.title: Desert Generals
programme.desc: This is the story of a final showdown between two titans of war in uninhibited warfare without buildings, cities or populations. In 1942 The British Army was being pushed back towards Cairo at a rate of almost 100 miles a day. Within a week, Rommel would take Egypt. The allies would lose the Mediterranean, Asia, the Iraq oilfields and its nascent US ally.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Lebanon War
programme.desc: In 1982, The Lebanon based Palestinian Liberation Organization began infiltrating Israeli borders with attacks that brought swift and powerful reprisals. Massive artillery and mortar attacks were traded across the border.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: In 1943 John Ford gave the great cinematographer Gregg Toland (Citizen Kane, The Grapes of Wrath) an opportunity to direct his first film. A veritable epic, framed by a debate between Walter Huston's Uncle Sam and Harry Davenport's Mr. C on the true nature of the Pacific paradise, Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: The war reaches new levels of intensity as it drags on, affecting civilian populations like never before. The concept of 'total war' becomes reality, with cities bombed into oblivion, resources stretched to their limits, and entire societies mobilized for the war effort. Strategic bombing campaigns against Germany and Japan begin to devastate industrial centers and civilian morale alike.

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: The power in Europe has finally and fatally shifted - the resurgent Germany of the Third Reich is the dominant force. War rips Spain apart as a three year civil war of terrible brutality starts.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Erich von Manstein's soldiers have trapped a massive Soviet force in Crimea, but the doomed troops have no intentions of surrendering, strongly motivated by patriotism. Manstein assembles the greatest concentration of artillery in history, which includes the world's biggest railway-gun nicknamed 'Dora,' and for eight months Soviets troops are savagely bombarded; destroying Sevastopol's only harbor.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: In 1943 John Ford gave the great cinematographer Gregg Toland (Citizen Kane, The Grapes of Wrath) an opportunity to direct his first film. A veritable epic, framed by a debate between Walter Huston's Uncle Sam and Harry Davenport's Mr. C on the true nature of the Pacific paradise, Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: About Executing Eichmann
programme.desc: Jewish historians and thinkers dwell on the importance of Eichmann's trial in Israël's history and on the violent debates provoked by his death sentence in the 60's in the intellectual and political sphere.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After a brutal day of relentless combat, the Allies secure a 50-mile bridgehead in Normandy. Now, American, British, and Canadian forces must push inland, capture a major supply port, and liberate Paris. Facing harsh terrain, supply shortages, and fierce German resistance, casualties soar into the hundreds of thousands in this costly battle for freedom.

programme.title: Desert Generals
programme.desc: This is the story of a final showdown between two titans of war in uninhibited warfare without buildings, cities or populations. In 1942 The British Army was being pushed back towards Cairo at a rate of almost 100 miles a day. Within a week, Rommel would take Egypt. The allies would lose the Mediterranean, Asia, the Iraq oilfields and its nascent US ally.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and the Beer Hall Putsch
programme.desc: One of the great ironies of history that Hitler's first assignment after the Great War was to help the Bavarian army to identify extremist political parties then to infiltrate and report back. One such party infiltrated by Hitler was the tiny German Workers Party. Hitler not only infiltrated the party but he took ownership, wrote a new manifesto and turned it into the Nazi party.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: As domestic markets shrink, nations worry about sustaining their defense industries by selling technologies abroad. Countries such as the United States and most European nations continue to develop new weapons as insurance against an uncertain future.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local farm for some expert tips for growing strawberries in Maine, then she shares her secret family strawberry shortcake recipe. She's also growing basil this summer, so she adds some fresh basil and strawberries to her homemade lemonade.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Strawberry Fields Forever

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: It's spring in Maine, so Lisa is planting seeds and getting ready for baby chicks. After making a fun DIY project for her chickens who lay eggs, she shares her best tips and attempts to get one of her hens to raise some baby chicks, then shares a recipe for Scotch Eggs.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - The Chicks are Coming!

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Meet some of Lisa's poultry pals, including a curious Indian runner duck named Fern and one of her French Marans hens who lays gorgeous chocolate brown eggs. Then she shares some of her best tips for raising a mixed flock of chickens, ducks and geese.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Poultry Pals

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa makes a visit to a lavender farm in Maine to learn all about growing and using the aromatic herb in baking and to make a natural chicken coop spray. Back at home, she bakes lavender cupcakes, makes some ice cream, then makes a chicken-themed cornhole game for the backyard.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Lavender in Bloom

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa heads to a lobster pound on the coast of Maine for a fresh seafood lunch, then gets some tips on cooking lobster. Back at home, she bakes a Maine favorite sweet treat - Whoopie pies - then builds a curbside stand using wooden pallets to sell fresh eggs and flowers.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Lobster Bake

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
programme.desc: Lisa makes a small basket using wood scraps and wire. Then she takes a trip to a local orchard and bakes an apple pie with some of the apples she's picked. She demonstrates how to make homemade apple cider vinegar, introduces several of her chickens, then makes them some apple treats.
programme.sub-title: Welcome to My Farm - Apple of my Eye

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia is in Charleston, South Carolina where she is preparing a dinner at historic Fenwick Hall. She invites a legendary queen of Southern cooking to come by and teach her the secret to her two ingredient biscuits, learns a Nigerian inspired cocktail from a local sommelier, and heads out on the water to harvest oysters. Georgia also shares her tips for setting a southern outdoor table.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Artisans of Charleston

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Traditions in Tuscany

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Earth, Women, Fire

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: For Jacques, a rite of spring is to enjoy the salad his father made every year at this time... Spring is also when asparagus appears and he pairs it with grilled tuna. He cooks fresh peas as soon as they arrive in the market and Jacques, not wanting to waste anything, uses the pods to make a soup. He ends with his friend Ed's Pasta Primavera...
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Springtime Favorites

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques enjoyed many new food trends. But on a cold damp night, he still craves classic dishes like onion soup or for a family dinner or an elegant meal, a roast chicken. For him, these dishes will never go out of fashion, just like the apple galette he's been making for decades.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Some Classics

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacues knows that most of us want to eat a healthy diet with lots of organic produce. Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don't have to spend a fortune if you chose what's in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you're in a hurry, it's okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Vegetables Every Way

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Today is all about sustainability; eating in a way that's good for us and the planet. Diane cooks up a colorful, mostly plant-based feast that celebrates fresh, local ingredients, big flavor, and a small footprint! She'll discuss the Mediterranean way of eating with legendary Greek physician, scientist, and nutritionist, Dr. Antonia Trichopoulou.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Sustainable Feasts

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Olive oil, the single most important ingredient in the Greek and Mediterranean diet and possible key to living longer. Diane talks to Harvard University School of Public Health Professor Emeritus Dr. Walter Willett about olive oil and longevity. In her kitchen, she'll cook up a menu of olive oil forward dishes and teach her son, Yiorgos, how to make olive oil chocolate mousse.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Olive Oil & Longevity

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Phyllo has been part of Greek cuisine for centuries and provides an easy backdrop to countless dishes, from appetizers to desserts. Diane has fun with phyllo creating; a crunchy topping to a spanakopita salad, a crispy phyllo pizza and finally a true Greek classic - baklava.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Phyllo for Healthy Fun

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In ancient Greece Plutarch famously stated, "We do not sit at a table to eat but to eat together." Diane cooks up a series of meze dishes that are easy to prepare, healthy, and made to be savored with others. She'll be speaking with Dr. Esther Sternberg, author of Well at Work and former Research Director, Andrew Weil Center for Integrative Medicine.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Hospitality on a Plate!

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Fasting is deeply rooted in Greek culture and religion. Diane explores some of the plant-based foods of abstention that make up part of the fasting diet and speaks with Professor Valter Longo, whose research on the benefits of fasting for longevity and wellness have catapulted him to global renown.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Delicious Abstention

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Grains are the feel-good food of the Greek and Mediterranean diet, providing nutrition, versatility and soul-warming comfort. Diane visits Pnyka bakery where they grind their own flour from an ancient strain of grain. In the kitchen, Diane shares her knowledge and love of grains with 3 easy Greek-Mediterranean recipes.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Comfort Grains

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Beans are a superfood linked to longevity and play a starring role in Greek cuisine. Diane explores dried vs. canned beans, visits an Athens legume shop, and chats with Dr. William Li on their health benefits. She shares satisfying, easy-to-make recipes to help you eat well and feel great.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Beans-The #1 Longevity Ingredient

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane embraces the words of Hippocrates, "Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food." She explores Greek staples-olive oil, herbs, nuts, veggies-as health foundations. Plus, three simple recipes and a chat with Dr. William Li, author of Eat to Beat Disease.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Touting the practicality of gondola travel, Joey explores the canals of Venice and discovers the oldest coffee shop in Europe. The trail to classic Italian espresso leads from Illy Coffee near the high-fashion metropolis of Trieste to the medieval town of Scarperia where espresso machines are manufactured. Florence boasts a famous barista who prepares a masterful farewell espresso.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: An exploration of Paris's distinctive cafe culture reveals a renaissance of coffee-inspired cuisine, pastries, and spirits. World-renowned "Noses" in the south of France reveal the complex contribution that fragrance and aroma make toward the perfect cup as Joey pursues the development of a coffee perfume.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Bob Marley's son Rohan takes Joey on a journey from the streets of Kingston to the peaks of the Blue Mountains. From waterfall plunges and grazing tropical fruits on Rohan's farm to roasting the smoothest coffee on earth and enjoying a Jamaican feast that ends with a Marley-hosted jam session, Joey discovers the pulse of Jamaica through the lens of Marley Coffee.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey hits the streets of Bogota to check out the controversial trade in emeralds, the famous Juan Valdez Cafe, and some classic Colombian cuisine at an elevation of 10,000 feet. A flight to Armenia and subsequent Willy's Jeep trek uncover a remote and hidden world of quaint coffee towns and boutique farms where Joey hosts a group of international coffee buyers.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In Diane's adopted city of Athens, the food scene has everything to offer, from mouthwatering Souvlaki to Michelin-starred haute Greek. In this insider's taste of the Greek capital, the amazing flavors of a bustling modern "ancient" city bubble over in every pot. Experience Athens like never before, through its timeless and groundbreaking cuisine.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Athens Rising

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane traces fillo pies from NYC to remote Greece, exploring origins. Learn to use fillo for savory and sweet
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Life of Pie

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane celebrates the intensely flavored food and unique wines of one of Greece's most breathtaking islands, Santorini. Diane hops in a boat to pick capers on this volcanic island. programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Flavors Of A Volcano

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

Diane follows feta cheese from its artisanal roots to modern state-of-the-art production and explores a range of other cheeses that are new to most Americans. Experience the wonderful world of Greek cheeses and learn how to use them to create an irresistibly cheesy menu.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greek Mountain Cheeses

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

She uncovers the vast variety and robust flavors of the meze table and invites a wine expert into the kitchen for advice on what to pair when the meal includes spice, yogurt, cheese, crunch, comfort, seafood, meat and more, all in one sitting. Discover the fun and festive meze tradition.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Meze Society

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

programme.desc: Forty-year-old pitcher Billy Chapel (Kevin Costner) is practically a dinosaur by professional baseball standards, fast approaching the end of his career. programme.title: The Babe
programme.desc: George Herman "Babe" Ruth (John Goodman) grows from a troubled boy who was sent to an orphanage to one of the most successful baseball players on record. Babe first becomes a power hitter and pitcher for the Boston Red Sox. After a falling-out with Red Sox owner Harry Frazee (Peter Donat), Babe is sold to the New York Yankees. He is idolized in New York, setting a record for home runs, as well as creating dramatic moments like hitting two homers for a sick boy in the hospital.

programme.title: The Best of Times

His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
programme.desc: Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake), who gave him the hideous burns that transformed him into his alter ego, Darkman. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. programme.title: Serial Mom

programme.title: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
programme.desc: Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case.

programme.title: Streets of Fire
programme.desc: Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: "Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: Turning Points in American History

programme.title: Turning Points in American History

programme.title: Return of Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Pai Wu Chin (Bruce Pak) is a stranger in town who is on a mission to find out the whereabouts of his missing brother (Bruce Le), who rumor has it, was murdered by the chief inspector of police. Pei Chiu Ting is the brother of the ex-chief inspector and is now the head samurai who wants Pai Wu killed on site. Non-stop action follows when Pai Wu meets Po Zu Pai, who together faces their common enemy and fights the samurai clan.

programme.title: The Iron Profligate
programme.desc: A detective and self-confessed profligate and martial artists of the highest caliber team up to smash an illegal gambling house and drug smuggling outfit.

programme.title: Ninja over the Great Wall
programme.desc: Ninja over the Great Wall takes place in the early nineteen-thirties when China was occupied by the Japanese imperial forces. Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.

programme.title: Method Man aka Fearless Young Boxer
programme.desc: After his father is murdered by a cold blooded killer, Xiao Lung joins an acrobat troupe in order to further his skills in martial arts. One day while performing he sees the killer, who is after other members of the troupe, like Xiao Lung's father they are-break away members of a large and powerful gang. Xiao Lung is no match for the killer, but after all the other members of the troupe are wiped out, it's up to Xiao Lung to get revenge on them all.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Art Camacho
programme.desc: Art Camacho is one of the premiere filmmakers in the martial arts industry. From a stuntman to a fight choreographer to the director's chair, Camacho's career includes over 22 film projects wit 36 credits in producing, acting and stuntwork. An award-winning film director, Camacho provides a candid interview about growing up Hispanic, the failures he faced, the influence Bruce Lee played on his life and what it took to break into the film industry.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leads to Tono-sama being treated like a VIP and the rest of everyone being scorned.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 11

programme.title: Deadly Silver Spear
programme.desc: A Wang Yu as Silver Spear meets the Flying Guillotine. He is hired by a noblewoman to do away with three top-class Kung Fu masters, but news reaches the ears of the white haired man, who deploys his own killers to deal with "Silver Spear". Unperturbed, "Silver Spear" continues on his mission to take down all three master fighters!

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai
programme.desc: The shogun falls in love with a mysterious woman who Jubei suspects to be a spy. With the Shogun's life on the line, Jubei and his ura-yagyus must hurry to find the truth before its too late.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub the Movie
programme.desc: A ronin Hai Itto (Manya Kinnosuke) is an assassin who travels with his son Daigoro (Okada Jizo) in a baby carriage. Itto is asked by the vassals of the Maruoka clan, whose feudal lord has been assassinated and the clan destroyed, to kill their underling, the official assassin Gunpei Yagyu (Katsuhiko Watahiki). Gunbei is the son of Retsudo Yagyu (Rentaro Mikuni), the chieftain of the Yagyu underlings.

programme.title: Six Directions Boxing
programme.desc: David Chiang, star of many classic Shaw Brothers films, and the great Yuen Hsiao Tien (Jackie Chan's Drunken Master) star in this kung fu bonanza set in China's warlord period. When a secret team is sent by the police to break up the revolutionaries and their arms movements, it will take more than just guns to annihilate them! Six Directions of Boxing is wall-to-wall, hand-to-hand kung fu mayhem!

programme.title: Mission Kiss & Kill
programme.desc: Lee stars as Constable Lu, an honest cop embarking on a mission to deliver eight valuable jade miniature horses to a wealthy lord. Blackie co-stars as Lu's partner, together the duo embark on a journey filled with danger and fights at every turn.

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Sensei Ed Smith trains Will in the secret art of power punching.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: SHUKOKAI KARATE with Ed Smith

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Will studies under Sensei Marques McCammon.
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: KOBAYASHI SHORIN-RYU with Marques McCammon

programme.title: Ninja vs Shaolin Guards aka Guards of Shaolin
programme.desc: Another action packed masterpiece from Robert Tai. After the Abbot of Shaolin is killed by their traitorous teacher a band of student monks embark on a mission to return the Golden Sutra to Tibet. They are joined on their quest by a beautiful female warrior - who aims to avenge her father's death. They traverse forests and mountains and weather challenges, all the while the students fight off deadly ninja assassins, vicious gangsters and even the undead.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: Through a series of manipulations and deceit, an evil mastermind causes a rift between the three for the extended season finale.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 21

programme.title: Bloody Spear at Mount Fuji
programme.desc: Gonpachi, the young master's spear-bearer, is exposed to the subtleties of human emotion on his journey, but when the young master is killed in a drinking dispute, he decides to avenge his death with his spear. A dramatization of the film of the same title, directed by Tomu Uchida and starring Chiezo Kataoka. Kojuro, a samurai, is traveling on the Tokaido Highway with his spear-bearer, Gonpachi, and Hasabako-bearer, Genta, to deliver a bowl of tea to an Edo residence.

programme.title: Return of the Red Tiger
programme.desc: Bruce Le stars as a dumb mute with excellent kung fu skills. His skills are put to the test when he comes up against some evil Japanese gangsters.

programme.title: Shanghai 13
programme.desc: A patriot finds evidence that the government is collaborating with a foreign power. He gets assistance from a local rebel leader who is in charge of a motley group of fighters called the Shanghai 13.

programme.title: Mantis Fists and Tiger Claws of Shaolin
programme.desc: When the local thugs harass a restaurant owner's daughter Shuang Shuang (Choi Chuk-Guen), a newcomer Pai (John Cheung) fends them off. When Pai goes off to the local brothel to find his long lost sister, the thugs rape Shuang Shuang, but get killed mysteriously later in the woods. The father of the thugs, Hung Chun Piao (Dean Shek), believes that Pai committed the murders and confronts him..

programme.title: Deadly Snail vs Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: In this kung fu fantasy, a daring duel of powers between the fairies, finds the young mortal Cheung rescuing the Sky Mussel Fairy. His bravery is not repaid, however, as Cheung is driven out of his home by his uncle. Now, Cheung must struggle to stay alive in a world of gods and demons, with only his kung fu powers to keep him safe.

programme.title: Golden Showdown
programme.desc: You'll know them when you see them! Returning to his home town and finding it overrun with ruthless gangsters led by Mr Chore, Richard sets out to stop their nefarious activities. A bloody conflict ensues, and when Richard's father is killed in retaliation he finds out that the law is no better. But then his sister is killed and Richard finally snaps, taking on the gang single-handedly and loaded to the very last bullet.

programme.title: 18 Jade Arhats (Aka Eighteen Jade Claws Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Kung Chih-Ya, disciple of Kung-Fu studied combat techniques with monk Liao Yuan. He had been pointed to guard precious Hotien 18 Jade's; statuettes representing 18 Kung-Fu strikes, each one can be deadly strike. Kung Chih-Ya guided by his master tirelessly learned techniques to counter the 18 knocks represented by the jades. Twenty years earlier 9 of the 18 statuettes mysteriously disappeared. Now Kung Chih-Ya must find the missing nine statues at any cost.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Hatsuuchi Suzuki, an official of the Tateyama Clan's Edo residence, attacked the axe-suke of Oshu, an Orizuke, and was beaten to death in a vicious revenge attack. Ittou, however, arrived a day too late. Itto met Hatsuuchi's children, Aya and Soichiro, who appealed to him for revenge. Itto slays Rikuzo in the gambling hall, Abukuma while eating, and Asuke who was with a woman, one after another. When he kills Asuke, he tells the woman who was with him: "If you are asked, you must answer.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: The bounty is at stake, and Hai Itto and Daigoro are declared publicly wanted criminals. The bounty hunters are always flocking to the scene, eager to get their hands on the 1,000 ryo bounty.
programme.sub-title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 7

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: The lone wolf made a promise to a dying undercover Yagyu ninja, to bring his wife to be together with him in the afterlife. This promise led Itto to a village with only women, whose sole purpose is to give birth to new ninjas.

programme.desc: Rutila vuela a Colombia para salvar a Javi, pero el rescate se complica, la instrucción es no aterrizar, por ahora. Al sobrevolar la pista, el piloto resulta herido, llaman a Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio guía a Javi por teléfono, quien toma el timón para aterrizar el avión que se quedó sin piloto en pleno vuelo. Rutila está en la cabina y trata de ayudar. Su amor se pone a prueba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Entre besos y abrazos, Aurelio amanece con Mecha, la admiración es mutua y él le pide que no le oculte nada. Aguirre descubre que la sobrina le miente a Zambrana, el tío se entera.
programme.sub-title: Más que un deseo, una realidad

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Manzano y Colón tienen motivos para sospechar de Tracy, la acorralan. Benjamín se la juega, cumple con la misión de colarse a la habitación de Saldaña para matarla, pero Carla sospecha.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La curiosidad de Mecha no tiene límites, quiere saber más de Corina y va al hospital con Roberta, lo que no imaginan es a quién más van a encontrar ahí, el susto es grande, se esconden.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha le sirve de informante a Aurelio; a escondidas, salen juntos del hospital, pero alguien más los observa, dejarse ver tan bien acompañados puede traerles problemas. Casillas toma medidas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una hermosa cabaña en medio de la nada es el escenario más romántico para Mecha y Aurelio, donde se dan un espacio para ser lo que quieren ser. Un atentado en la fonda le cuesta muy caro a Artemia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio quiere vivir toda la vida junto a Mecha, pero ella dice que están inmersos en una fantasía. La Felina logra comunicarse con Casillas y lo pone al tanto del ataque a la fonda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Mecha amanecen juntos, al despertar, él le da la mala noticia, furiosa, reclama por qué no se lo dijo antes, él intenta explicar, pero es inútil, la decisión está tomada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha le hace una promesa a Artemia, mientras Aurelio está fuera de sus cabales, es imperdonable lo que pasó en la fonda. Los Rayados, camuflados, entran al hospital, buscan a su objetivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas promete que lo que va a pasar no lo detiene nadie, como cazador busca a su presa, La Felina lo acompaña y lo incentiva para demoler al enemigo. Colón contacta al Señor de los Cielos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aislados de todo, Colón y Casillas se ven las caras. Es la hora de la verdad. Ismael y Caridad coordinan con Saade mover cinco toneladas de droga bajo la mirada atenta de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El operativo de la DEA para capturar a Ismael está en marcha. La Greñas manda una alerta. El hijo de Casillas y Skinny se sienten traicionados y amenazan a sus potenciales socios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas usa el mejor recurso que tiene, amenaza al mismísimo presidente de México, le da un plazo de una hora para que dejen en libertad a su hijo, Ismael.
